name: Dyshormogenetic goiter
description: A goiter caused by impaired synthesis or action of thyroid hormones, leading to compensatory thyroid enlargement.

name: Nontoxic diffuse goiter
description: Diffuse enlargement of the thyroid gland without evidence of hyperthyroidism, often due to iodine deficiency or other non-toxic causes.

name: Nontoxic multinodular goiter
description: Nontoxic multinodular goitre, also known as an inactive multinodular goitre, is an enlargement of the thyroid gland, which develops multiple nodules without affecting thyroid hormone function. In the United States it is the most common cause of an enlarged thyroid, affecting between 3–5% of the population.

name: Nontoxic goiter, unspecified
description: A diffuse enlargement of the thyroid gland without associated hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism.

name: Congenital hypothyroidism without goiter
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Congenital hypothyroidism without goiter.

name: Other specified nontoxic goiter
description: A slowly enlarging thyroid gland without evidence of hyperthyroidism or iodine deficiency, often diagnosed after other causes are excluded.

name: Congenital hypothyroidism with diffuse goiter
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Congenital hypothyroidism with diffuse goiter.

name: Neonatal goiter, not elsewhere classified
description: A thyroid enlargement in a newborn due to iodine deficiency or maternal thyroid disease, presenting with neck swelling and potential compressive symptoms.

name: Chronic thyroiditis with transient thyrotoxicosis
description: Chronic thyroiditis with transient thyrotoxicosis is an autoimmune thyroid inflammation that temporarily elevates thyroid hormone levels before returning to euthyroid state.

name: Thyrotoxicosis factitia without thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Thyrotoxicosis factitia without thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Thyrotoxicosis factitia with thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Thyrotoxicosis factitia with thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Other thyrotoxicosis without thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other thyrotoxicosis without thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Other thyrotoxicosis with thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other thyrotoxicosis with thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Thyrotoxicosis, unspecified without thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Thyrotoxicosis, unspecified without thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Thyrotoxicosis, unspecified with thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Thyrotoxicosis, unspecified with thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Thyrotoxicosis with diffuse goiter without thyrotoxic crisis or storm
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Thyrotoxicosis with diffuse goiter without thyrotoxic crisis or storm.

name: Postinfectious hypothyroidism
description: Postinfectious hypothyroidism is a delayed onset of hypothyroid symptoms following an acute viral or bacterial infection.

name: Hypothyroidism, unspecified
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Hypothyroidism, unspecified.

name: Postprocedural hypothyroidism
description: Postprocedural hypothyroidism is a transient or permanent reduction in thyroid hormone production following thyroid surgery, radioiodine therapy, or neck irradiation.

name: Other specified hypothyroidism
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other specified hypothyroidism.

name: Subclinical iodine-deficiency hypothyroidism
description: A mild form of hypothyroidism caused by insufficient iodine intake, presenting with subtle biochemical changes but minimal clinical symptoms.

name: Hypothyroidism due to medicaments and other exogenous substances
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Hypothyroidism due to medicaments and other exogenous substances.

name: Type 1 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Type 1 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia.

name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia.

name: Other specified diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other specified diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia.

name: Diabetes mellitus due to underlying condition with hyperglycemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Diabetes mellitus due to underlying condition with hyperglycemia.

name: Drug or chemical induced diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia
description: Sudden onset of hyperglycemia due to exposure to certain drugs or chemicals that impair insulin secretion or action.

name: Other hypoglycemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other hypoglycemia.

name: Hypoglycemia, unspecified
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Hypoglycemia, unspecified.

name: Hypoglycemia level 1
description: Hypoglycemia level 1 is a mild drop in blood glucose below normal thresholds, often asymptomatic or presenting with mild adrenergic symptoms.

name: Hypoglycemia level 2
description: A moderate drop in blood glucose requiring intervention but not life-threatening.

name: Hypoglycemia level 3
description: A severe hypoglycemic episode with neuroglycopenic symptoms requiring immediate medical intervention.

name: Iatrogenic neonatal hypoglycemia
description: Iatrogenic neonatal hypoglycemia is a transient low blood glucose condition in newborns caused by medical interventions such as excessive glucose infusion or delayed feeding.

name: Other neonatal hypoglycemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other neonatal hypoglycemia.

name: Drug-induced hypoglycemia without coma
description: Drug-induced hypoglycemia without coma is a sudden drop in blood glucose levels caused by medication, presenting with neuroglycopenic symptoms but no loss of consciousness.

name: Autosomal dominant hypocalcemia
description: A genetic disorder characterized by low serum calcium, high serum phosphate, and low urinary calcium excretion due to activating mutations in the calcium-sensing receptor or GNA11 gene.

name: Other neonatal hypocalcemia
description: A endocrine-metabolic condition known as Other neonatal hypocalcemia.

name: Cow's milk hypocalcemia in newborn
description: A neonatal condition characterized by low serum calcium due to inadequate intake or absorption, often associated with cow's milk-based formula feeding.

name: Hypertrophy of breast
description: Breast hypertrophy is a rare medical condition of the breast connective tissues in which the breasts become excessively large. The condition is often divided based on the severity into two types, macromastia and gigantomastia.

name: Primary hyperparathyroidism
description: Excess PTH secretion from one or more parathyroid glands, most often due to a solitary adenoma, causing hypercalcemia. The most common cause of hypercalcemia in outpatients.

name: Hypercalcemia of malignancy
description: Elevated serum calcium caused by an underlying malignancy, most commonly via PTH-related protein secretion, osteolytic bone metastases, or ectopic calcitriol production. The most common cause of hypercalcemia in hospitalized patients.
